searchText: Would there be any advantage in testing a rollback, e.g. to a pre merge block on one of the testnets that are being sunset? Maybe even more than one time? I guess different scenarios could be tested (merge fails amd we roll back pre merge, consensus bug post merge, ...) Probably the test could not be finished till the merge so a failed merge scenario might be obsolete... I can't think of any situation where we would want to rollback. I think the risk of rollback is just so much higher than moving forward in basically all scenarios. For starters, miners may not be available to mine at the necessary difficulty if they have all shutdown already.
